violation_type.title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis (26 TAC §744.1507(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: There was a ratio of 1 caregiver to 51 children for the first 15 minutes of the start of the program.      This was corrected at the inspection when additional staff arrived at the operation.

finding_variants.text: There was a ratio of 1 caregiver to 51 children for the first 15 minutes of the start of the program.      This was corrected at the inspection when additional staff arrived at the operation.
One caregiver was observed caring for a group of 27 children on the playground.     This was corrected when the other caregiver returned.
A caregiver was observed alone with a group of children exceeding the classroom total for the youngest child in the group. this was corrected when a second caregiver returned to the room.
